notes.title: Post processing Update #1

notes.title: Inventory Update FIX #1
notes.content:
[h1] Update 1.1 – Inventory & Multiplayer Enhancements[/h1][p]
[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p]
[/p][list][*][p][b]Inventory System:[/b] Collect, manage, and organize items in a new inventory.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item Interaction:[/b] Added the ability to pick up and drop items from de quick slot.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick Slots:[/b] Assign items to quick-access slots for faster in-game use.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Multiplayer Fixes[/h2][p]

[/p][/*][/list]
